ITEM 1 | Triangular slice with a golden-orange crust edge, bright red-orange tomato sauce base, and melted pale yellow cheese with browning spots; two round slices of reddish-pink cured meat sit on top, one large and one partly under the cheese, with glossy fatty sheen; slice occupies roughly 12% of the plate's surface, about 10 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, sits at upper right edge of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Three pieces of bright orange cooked carrot, each cut into rounds or half-rounds about 3-4 cm long and 2 cm wide, with a smooth, slightly glossy, firm surface and a pale cream-colored spot in the center of one piece; pieces are clustered together beside the slice at lower right of the food area, covering roughly 5% of the plate | 45
